task.description:
Extend the scheduler/task design for SCH-04 in src/design/scheduler.md.

SCH-04 requires HUMAN_TASK nodes with escalation_timer_duration to create an escalation timer when the task is activated (EE-03), fire an ESCALATION event if the task is still PENDING when due, and optionally reassign the task in the same transaction as the ESCALATION event. Completing the task before the timer fires must cancel the escalation timer atomically per SCH-03.

Design requirements:
- Define the timer payload/data contract that distinguishes escalation timers from the existing scheduler timers.
- Specify module boundaries across task activation, scheduler polling/firing, task store mutation, and event append persistence.
- Preserve the pure-function rule in src/engine/transition.zig.
- Specify the transactional path for firing escalation timers, including task-still-pending guard and optional reassignment in the same transaction as ESCALATION.
- Clarify how SCH-03 cancellation applies when the task completes before escalation.
- Add acceptance traceability for SCH-04 and implementation notes for BACKEND-DEV and downstream test agents.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/scheduler.md documents SCH-04 escalation timer behavior and ownership boundaries
Design defines timer payload/contract for escalation timers created from EE-03 task activation
Design specifies atomic ESCALATION event append and optional task reassignment transaction
Design preserves transition purity and explains SCH-03 cancellation interaction
Design includes implementation notes and acceptance traceability for SCH-04

result.summary: Extended the scheduler design for SCH-04 in src/design/scheduler.md with a distinct escalation-timer contract, activation/completion/firing transaction paths, scheduler-task-event ownership boundaries, SCH-03 cancellation interaction, acceptance traceability, and downstream implementation/test notes.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) and TEST-DESIGNER for SCH-04 implementation and validation planning.
